counter_caveats: Use SHADOW/PRIMITIVES_IN_FRAME to compare cache eligibility.
Pinned GLES does not fill SHADOW/DRAW_CALLS_IN_FRAME; its VISIBLE/DRAW_CALLS_IN_FRAME includes shadow passes (rasterizer_scene_gles3.cpp:3929). Raw visible_draws are not color-pass draws.
Mobile shadow draw count is overwritten per pass (render_forward_mobile.cpp:1600); not a full-frame aggregate.
Normal Engine.get_frames_drawn progression is required. force_draw and minimized X11 windows do not establish native cache behavior.
